a1.title: What “AI Fit” adds beyond a GPA line on the website
a1.lead: Official pages show thresholds; you still need to see competitiveness for your track and documents.
a1.body: Our MVP averages fit across programs, lists gaps (scores + missing files), and anchors deadlines to a checklist—so “Strong Match” is tied to your saved profile, not brochure text.

a2.title: Three checklist traps before you hit “Submit”
a2.lead: Medical certificates, diploma scans, and English proof often expire or need re-uploads.
a2.body: Follow the vertical timeline, upload in the demo where enabled, and trigger Qwen only when your profile is saved—fewer surprises on the real admissions portal.

a3.title: Scholarship essays: one story, many forms
a3.lead: Merit and need-based forms reuse the same facts—structure beats starting from a blank page each time.
a3.body: Draft a single narrative spine (motivation, obstacle, outcome, why this field). Map bullet answers per prompt, then tighten word counts. Tie claims to evidence already in your profile so reviewers see consistency.
a3.extra: In QApp, scholarship tiles highlight gaps vs your GPA, English, and olympiad flags—align essay bullets with those signals.

a4.title: Deadline math: portal time vs your timezone
a4.lead: “23:59 university time” is easy to miss when your clock shows something else.
a4.body: Convert once, write it on the timeline, and pad by one day for uploads that fail checksum or antivirus scans. If early rounds exist, note whether documents must arrive earlier than the form submit.
a4.extra: Pair each milestone with a checklist row so “almost done” doesn’t drift past close.

a5.title: Shortlisting without drowning in programs
a5.lead: High fit isn’t permission to apply everywhere—focus protects essay quality and fees.
a5.body: Lock two safety targets, two matches, and one reach where your gaps are fixable before submit. Re-run fit after every profile edit so the grid reflects fresh scores, not stale optimism.
a5.extra: Use shortlist stars on program cards to keep the set visible from the dashboard.
